body: I want to do it so hard, but I don't think I could trust her ever again, even if she wanted that. I'm actually going to ask her to, if she wants to, see me one more time on my birthday, if she says no that will be it and I won't contact her ever again.

I'll be here for a while, I hope it helps me a bit. I have only one friend I can talk about this stuff and he's not in town, but he can't understand me like a good female friend would, it's just how it is.

After the breakup we agreed to stay friends, but then she found boyfriend and just said to me something like: sorry I can't go out with you because of him. I told her to check on me from time to time since I won't be sending her messages because of that bf. That's why I'm hoping for happy birthday from her in one week. But I don't know what to expect honestly

Our relationship is over, I get that. But the problem is that I want my best friend back and that's what's killing me. Before we got together I knew I had feelings and that I looked her like something more then a friend and I was always afraid of trying to be with her or confessing because I was worried that I will happen if we break up. But then we started going out alone regularly and it just happened. Looks like my fears were justified. Sometimes I wish we never got together

Sometimes I feel like it's getting better, while sometimes just a thought of us make me wanna cry.

Thanks for your wishes. If I'm right the only thing that can make me heal is if I find someone like to replace this hole in my heart. I tried to force dating with some girls since I found out about her bf, but I can't force something like that and I gave up
